notes: Leap-year rule: Gregorian (4/100/400) vs Julian (every 4th year) — disagree on 1900, 2100, 1500.
Month indexing: 1..12 vs 0..11 — shifts every result by one month and changes which inputs are invalid.
Out-of-range month: raise ValueError vs wrap modulo 12 with year carry (13 -> Jan next year, 0 -> Dec prev year).
Historical reform: October 1582 has 21 days and pre-1582 years use the Julian rule vs proleptic Gregorian everywhere.
Year domain: proleptic (year 0 and negative years accepted, year 0 is a leap year) vs datetime-backed (year must be 1..9999, else ValueError).
